remarks: This charming main floor unit showcases elegant hardwood floors, a spacious kitchen with ample counter space, modern appliances, and a large family room offering flexible use as a potential third bedroom. Additionally, it features a dedicated laundry room with a washer and dryer. Set on a picturesque 0.45-acre lot with beautiful landscaping, the property strikes a perfect balance between convenience and privacy.  Located at the end of a tranquil cul-de-sac off Hogan Trail, you'll be within walking distance to the train station, local shops, restaurants, and the lively Saugatuck neighborhood. Enjoy easy access to Saugatuck Shores and Compo Beach for a genuine coastal experience. The backyard is equipped with a deck, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining.
